prefix_messages.content:
[kernel_contract]
Trusted kernel enforces typed action schema, stores receipts instead of transcript memory, blocks illegal edits/external targets under local-only policy, and only finishes through the completion gate.

[task_prompt]
I have provided a file called text.gcode. This is a gcode file for a Prusa MK4s. I'm trying to print some text onto an existing object. When I run the print, what will the text show? Write the output to /app/out.txt

[architect_summary]
Task is a single-file local artifact interpretation: read text.gcode, infer the printed text result, and write that exact inferred output to /app/out.txt. No services, network, or package setup are needed.

[proof_plan]
["Open /app/text.gcode and identify the motion/toolpath segments responsible for the text feature.","Infer the final human-readable text represented by the print path ordering and geometry.","Write the inferred text exactly to /app/out.txt.","Re-open /app/out.txt to confirm content is present and matches the inferred text."]

[solver_identity]
You are a precise fabrication-file analyst. Inspect the provided G-code, determine what visible text it would print onto the object, and write only that resulting text output to /app/out.txt.

[selected_capabilities]
[{"available":true,"capability_id":"artifact_inspection","cost_hint":"moderate","summary":"Inspect artifacts (text, binary, structured data)","tool_names":["inspect_artifact"]},{"available":true,"capability_id":"filesystem","cost_hint":"cheap","summary":"Read and write files in the workspace","tool_names":["read_file","write_file"]},{"available":true,"capability_id":"shell","cost_hint":"cheap","summary":"Execute shell commands via bash","tool_names":["run_command"]}]
